name: contract-base
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=2n width=1n rise=50p fall=50p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.9 1.6n 0.9 1.7n 0 60n 0]
Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.45 7.5n 0.535 22n 0.535 22.1n 0.77 36n 0.77 36.1n 0.54 60n 0.54]
XDUT (clk rst vin out metric gain_mon rssi_mon) agc_receiver_leveling_loop

tran tran stop=60n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save clk rst vin out metric gain_mon rssi_mon

name: contract-stretched-input
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=2.46n width=1.23n rise=50p fall=50p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.9 1.968n 0.9 2.091n 0 73.8n 0]
Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.45 9.225n 0.535 27.06n 0.535 27.183n 0.77 44.28n 0.77 44.403n 0.54 73.8n 0.54]
XDUT (clk rst vin out metric gain_mon rssi_mon) agc_receiver_leveling_loop

tran tran stop=73.8n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save clk rst vin out metric gain_mon rssi_mon
